name: 精霊 - トリ
effect: 【条件】自分の場にモンスターがいない状態で、自分のターンを5回終了する · 【報酬】自分の最大体力+30
scene: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one finished LORE inner-card painting, landscape aspect 1.095:1, no card frame or text. Spirit Tori MUST be a DOG based closely on the first two reference photos: small scruffy warm tan dog, dark brown/black floppy feathered ears, large round dark eyes, black nose, pale cream muzzle/chin and chest, slender forelegs and feathery curled tail. Preserve these recognizable facial features and proportions; no bird, wings, antlers or humanoid. The third image is ONLY the refined hand-painted fantasy illustration style, not its person or architecture. Setting: intimate mossy woodland pool at sunrise, low ferns, warm amber fireflies, roots and small white flowers. Tori rests one forepaw forward on moss and looks gently toward viewer; body mostly solid, a subtle golden spirit glow along fur tips and tail, no costume obscuring fur, one tiny leaf charm allowed. Express quiet companionship and sanctuary (quest requires turns with no monsters, reward vitality). Dog occupies 60% of frame, entire ears paws tail inside central80%; painterly depth, fine expressive eyes, soft brush texture, luminous but restrained. No white stone buildings, arches, plinths, compass-star decoration, modern bedding, social media UI, captions or watermarks.
prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Generate one replacement LORE TCG interior illustration, approximately 1472x1344, no lettering or card frame. Image 1 is the authoritative illustration style: the delicate drawn contours, selectively simplified shapes and painterly colored shadow planes of the elf illustration. Apply that exact DRAWN character treatment to the DOG and to the background. Image 2 is the rejected dog design, use ONLY to retain dog identity, markings and setting. The rejected dog's photographic fur and photographic face MUST be completely replaced.
The whole finished image must clearly be a hand-drawn fantasy game illustration: fine intentional contour lines, grouped sculpted fur locks with clean designed edges, broad painted light/shadow planes, expressive simplified dark eyes with one modest highlight, a simplified matte black nose and a gracefully designed muzzle. Do not draw thousands of individually realistic hairs, nose pores, wet photographic specular detail, camera bokeh, lens depth of field or photoreal lighting. Medium stylization appropriate to image 1; not a photo filter, not a plush toy, not chibi, not a mascot logo or children's cartoon. Refined, warm character presence, painted fantasy atmosphere. Dog stays entirely canine with four legs, no clothing, humanoid limbs, horns, wings or armor. Face and main silhouette central with framing margin. The dog and setting must use one consistent drawn illustration technique.
Subject: Tori, a small wiry warm tan companion dog with black/dark-brown floppy feathered ears, large dark eyes, short pale cream muzzle and cream chest, slender forelegs and curled feathery tail. Preserve the characteristic dark hanging ears and pale beard of the second image. Resting on a moss-covered root with one forepaw extended, warm fern woodland and a quiet pool. Render tan fur as tasteful angular flowing painted locks and black ears as coherent dark shapes with a few drawn tufts. Sparse gold spirit motes and a delicate gold rim along tail, not a realistic rim-lit photograph. A few small white flowers and fern fronds; forest foliage drawn in grouped leaf silhouettes and layered brush shapes, not photographic macro detail. Color family muted warm ochre, moss green, parchment cream and subtle amber light.
